package.name: tabletop_perception
package.description: Tabletop object perception and antipodal grasp detection from an RGB-D camera: support-plane segmentation, color-classified objects with poses and extents, multi-view fusion, and parallel-jaw antipodal grasps. A ROS-free core (tabletop_perception.core) plus a node serving it. Robot- and task-agnostic: robots, cameras, palettes and grippers come from YAML. Needs Open3D (pip, see SETUP.md) - run the node from the environment that has it.
